name: Hsin Kao Gas Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hsin Kao Gas Co.,Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise that supplies natural gas to residential and commercial clients across the nation. Its operations also encompass the creation, procurement, and distribution of natural gas appliances and related equipment. Furthermore, the company actively participates in and invests in the natural gas sector, alongside providing industrial fuels. Established in 1972, its headquarters are located in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
